description:
LinkedIn Jobs Scraper: Public Job Listings, No Login

Scrape public LinkedIn job listings by keyword and location: title, company, location, posting date, plus optional full description, seniority, employment type and applicant count. No login.

Pricing (pay per event, billed to your Apify account): Job listing: $0.0005; Job details: $0.0012.

Runs on Apify as subimpact/linkedin-jobs-api.

_maxChargeUsd.description: Per-run spending cap in USD (default 0.5). Passed to Apify as the run option maxTotalChargeUsd, so the run stops when it reaches this charge.
_maxChargeUsd.title: Max charge (USD)

_maxItems.description: How many dataset items to return to the model (1-1000, default 50). Truncates the response only; it does not change what the Actor collects or charges for.
_maxItems.title: Max items returned

detailConcurrency.description: How many detail pages to fetch in parallel when includeDetails is on. Rows are still delivered and charged one at a time, in listing order. Higher is faster, lower is gentler on LinkedIn.
detailConcurrency.title: Detail page concurrency

experienceLevel.description: Internship through executive. Leave empty for all.
experienceLevel.title: Experience level

includeDetails.description: Fetch each job's public detail page for the full description, seniority level, employment type, job function, industries, applicant count and the apply type. Adds one request and one extra charge per job.
includeDetails.title: Include job details

jobType.description: Full-time, part-time, contract, temporary or internship. Leave empty for all.
jobType.title: Job type

maxJobsPerSearch.description: Cap on delivered jobs per search (1 to 1000). LinkedIn's guest endpoint stops returning cards around start=990, so a search yields at most about 1,000 jobs.
maxJobsPerSearch.title: Max jobs per search

maxTotalJobs.description: Global cap across every search in one run. This is the hard cost ceiling. Set 0 for no limit.
maxTotalJobs.title: Max total jobs

postedWithin.description: Keep jobs posted in the last 24 hours, week or month. LinkedIn applies this as the f_TPR filter.
postedWithin.title: Posted within

proxyCountry.description: Two-letter country for the residential proxy session, for example US or MY. LinkedIn throttles datacenter IPs, so the Actor always runs through Apify residential proxy.
proxyCountry.title: Proxy country

searchUrls.description: LinkedIn jobs search URLs copied from your browser, for example https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/search/?keywords=data%20engineer&location=Malaysia&f_WT=2. keywords, location and the f_TPR, f_WT, f_JT, f_E, sortBy and geoId filters are read from the URL. Use either this or searches.
searchUrls.title: LinkedIn search URLs

searches.description: Keyword and location pairs. Each pair is one LinkedIn job search. Example: [{"keywords":"data engineer","location":"Malaysia"}]. Use either this or searchUrls. With neither, the prefilled demo search runs and nothing else.

keywords.description: Job title or search terms, for example data engineer.
keywords.title: Keywords

location.description: City, region or country, for example Malaysia or Singapore. Leave empty for LinkedIn's default location.
location.title: Location

searches.title: Searches

sortByDate.description: Ask LinkedIn to sort by posting date instead of relevance.
sortByDate.title: Newest first

workplaceType.description: On-site, remote or hybrid. Leave empty for all.
workplaceType.title: Workplace type

name: linkedin_jobs
